transactions.notes: Acquired via DH-CRUX Japan TMK. Freehold logistics property in Fujioka-shi, Gunma (Greater Tokyo). DISCLOSED acquisition discount (not derived): -23.4% (sign convention: negative = acquired below independent valuation). Financed by JPY 3,990m borrowings drawn to fund the acquisition.
